selection_basis: The primary composition uses the already selected lane winners: ZITADEL for identity, OPA for authorization and OpenBao for credential brokering.
The primary composition passed all 20 frozen Stage B steps under one isolated LAB network with no production credentials or authority.
Each selected lane fallback also passed the same 20-step shared fixture when swapped one-at-a-time around the primary composition: Keycloak, Cedar and Infisical.
The frozen contract explicitly does not require Cartesian exhaustion; the one-at-a-time fallback swaps prove the selected interoperability paths without a 3x3x2 bake-off.
All four composition receipts record fail-closed dependency behavior, no host-port exposure and no raw secret or bearer material.
promotion_limits: This verdict closes the Phase 3B architecture/composition gate only; it does not grant SHADOW, PILOT or production authority.
CURRENT.json remains at the Phase 3A closed/Phase 3B ready checkpoint until a separate project-state promotion is explicitly authorized.
Any production-adjacent integration must preserve default DENY, scoped credential access, observable revocation, rollback and explicit authority-transfer receipts.
next_gate: Prepare integration wiring and later SHADOW/PILOT promotion gates for the selected composition. Production authority remains unchanged until a separate explicit promotion receipt.
